## Purpose

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[Download the PDF version of this guide](index.pdf).
:::

The independent desk review found the main report strong. Its main concern was
that the report and the linked CMP descriptions, results, downloads, and
instructions did not always tell one consistent story.

The material stemming from the MSE is organized according to what each reader
needs:

1. a short [SC14 questions and tasks paper](decision-paper.qmd) tells the
   Scientific Committee what the results show, which questions it needs to
   answer, and what advice is being requested;
2. the [full MSE report](../evidence/sc14-mse-report.qmd) provides the complete
   scientific account of the analysis and results;
3. a [technical paper](technical-paper.qmd) gives the methods, definitions,
   full results, and details needed to check the work; and
4. a [response to the review](review-response.qmd) shows what has been changed,
   what remains to be done, and when it should be completed.

The website, CMP list, downloadable results, Slick file, and code should all be
produced from the same final set of results. A reader should not have to compare
different pages or downloads to discover which numbers are current.

## Document roles

| Paper or supporting item | Main readers | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| SC14 questions and tasks | Scientific Committee and Commission delegates | Summarize the results, choices, and requested advice |
| Full MSE report | Scientific Committee and scientific reviewers | Provide the complete scientific analysis and interpretation |
| Technical paper | Scientific reviewers and analysts | Give enough detail to understand and check the work |
| Response to the review | Scientific Committee, reviewer, and authors | Show how each important comment has been handled |
| Saved results and code | Analysts and future reviewers | Provide the exact files used to make the papers, tables, figures, and downloads |

::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}
The papers, CMP descriptions, tables, figures, Slick file, and code all use the
same final saved results. The full MSE report provides the scientific account,
the technical paper provides supporting detail, and the short SC14 paper sets
out the questions and tasks. SC14 advice then guides completion of the
instructions for annual use before the Commission chooses a CMP.
:::

## SC14 tasks

The papers allow SC14 to decide whether the MSE is scientifically sound,
agree the minimum biological performance requirements, and recommend a short
list of CMPs for final work. SC14 should also identify the questions that need a Commission choice,
especially the acceptable balance between catch, stability, and risk.

Before the Commission chooses a CMP, the remaining rules for annual use should
be completed. These include treatment of missing or revised data and the action
to take when circumstances fall outside those tested in the MSE. Catch
allocation does not require further analytical work for this paper. The
author's response explains how the existing analysis addresses the review
comments on allocation. The final papers, results, website files, and code will
be saved together as the official version.
